name: Heatmap
description: Heatmap — a generic grid of value-coloured cells on a low→high gradient
descriptionFull:
Heatmap — a generic grid of value-coloured cells on a low→high gradient.

Presentational and domain-agnostic: pass a row-major matrix of cells and an optional `[min, max]` range (auto-derived otherwise). Use `renderCell` to overlay domain content (socket borders, selection, tooltips) without forking the primitive — the grid still owns each cell's background colour. Pair with {@link HeatmapLegend} for a gradient scale

props.name: data
props.description: Rows of cells (row-major). Rows may be ragged

props.name: min
props.description: Range floor (maps to the first gradient stop); auto-derived from the finite values when omitted

props.name: max
props.description: Range ceiling (maps to the last gradient stop); auto-derived from the finite values when omitted

props.name: colors
props.description: Gradient stops low→high. Defaults to the cold→hot `HEATMAP_GRADIENT`

props.name: showValues
props.description: Render each cell's value/label as text

props.name: renderCell

props.descriptionFull: Override the cell's inner content — e.g. to overlay socket borders, selection, or tooltips for a PDU grid. The primitive still owns the cell's background colour (passed via `context.color`)

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class for the root element
